projects.title: DDA Globe
projects.caption: Visual reference / curated image
projects.body: Document Design Act is my independent creative practice. It grew from three ongoing Instagram blogs — a place for visual curiosity, curation and stories that connect words with images.

points.detail: Curated imagery across three active blogs.

projects.title: Stories that make space for people
projects.caption: Visual reference / curated image
projects.body: My digital storytelling work includes the University of Melbourne and galleries. I look for the human detail — the observation, voice or image that gives a story its meaning.

threads.title: Paying Attention
threads.detail: I notice what people say — and what they leave unsaid. Those quiet human details are where the work begins.

threads.detail: I’m drawn to beauty that lingers and colour that moves us — the kind of feeling that stays long after the page turns.
